description: Matched 96-month logical matrices assembled from 72 completed independent cases against immutable runtime checkouts. External harness and full-matrix seed indices are identical across variants. Actual endpoint days are retained for early endings. These are adjacent-bot diagnostics, not human balance acceptance. Cityless but not eliminated does not establish military viability; only two specific waiting-party cases have been inspected with full final saves.

assembly.note: 24 independently executed cases with original full-matrix seed indices. Source, external harness, model, configuration, unique case coverage and seeds verified before assembly. The common fingerprint describes the logical full matrix; per-case commands/config hashes and raw report hashes remain below. Parallel runtime totals are not performance measurements.
